items.title: Kallas Says Russia's Mockery Of UN Meeting Shows It's Not Interested In Ending Ukraine War
items.description: European Union foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said on September 28 that Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov's treatment of his German counterpart, Johann Wadephul, after their recent UN meeting demonstrates that Russia is not interested in peace in Ukraine.

items.description: Tra i sanzionati giudici della Corte suprema e giudice che ha condannato Shlosberg

items.title: Ethiopia accuses Sudan, Egypt of backing Tigray rebels as fighting rages
items.description: Sudan army denies backing Tigray fighters, says rival paramilitary RSF receiving support from within Ethiopia.

items.title: Trump granting asylum to Afrikaners is 'race-based policy', South African FM claims
items.description: In an interview with FRANCE 24 on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, South African Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola said Washington's plan to take in up to 17,500 more White South Africans was "a race-based policy", dismissing the "so-called genocide" of Afrikaners as "fake news".

items.title: Israel says it killed in Gaza October 7 attacker who abducted hostage couple
items.description: Abducted at the Nova Festival, near the border with the Palestinian enclave, during the Hamas attack, Noa Argamani and Avinatan Or were released more than a year apart, in June 2024 and October 2025, respectively.

items.title: What Matters More to Putin? Russian Refineries or Striking Ukraine?
items.description: Kyiv Post Senior Defense Correspondent Stefan Korshak joins TVP World to discuss whether an energy ceasefire could pave the way for broader negotiations, how Ukrainian strikes are affecting Russia’s war economy, and why the Kremlin continues to favor military pressure over compromise.

items.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
items.description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

items.title: Five arrested near UK air base used by U.S. bombers in Iran war
items.description: U.K. police say five men were arrested on suspicion of preparation of a terrorist act after three vehicles were spotted near an air base the U.S. military has been using to launch attacks on Iran.

items.title: UN ambassador Waltz says Iran was not negotiating ‘in good faith’ to end war
items.description: Waltz says Trump rejected Iran’s proposal to end war because they ‘were asking for everything up front’The Trump administration’s ambassador to the United Nations said the US rejected Iran’s proposal to end the ongoing war there because Iranian negotiators “were asking for everything up front”.Echoing comments by Donal…

items.title: Russian and German FMs Meet for First Time Since Ukraine Invasion
items.description: Russia’s Foreign Ministry said that the ministers discussed bilateral relations and the war in Ukraine.

items.title: Russia expected to intensify hybrid war on Europe
items.description: Drone explosions, airspace violations, arson attacks: Poland, Romania, and Moldova are now regularly targeted in Russian attacks against Ukraine. More governments are calling these attacks deliberate acts of aggression.

items.title: Countries far from conflict paying the price for wars not their own, India tells UN
items.description: India’s External Affairs Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar warned on Saturday that violent conflicts continue to undermine international peace and security, while countries far removed from the battlefield are being forced to pay a heavy price.

items.title: Hoping to push the US away, Iran’s strategy is to go on the offensive
items.description: Nearly seven months after being attacked, an emboldened Iran is seeking to end the war on its terms. That means forcing U.S. bases out, lifting sanctions, and ending a U.S. naval blockade.
